questions.prompt: Describing exactly which one: Your partner is deciding what to do after this account. Give a relevant suggestion, ask about one missing practical detail, and respond aloud to the possibility that their plan differs.
questions.context:
朋友问：“你昨天穿的衣服在哪里买的？我也想买一件。”我说：“那件红色的衣服是妈妈给我的。”

我们去了商店。朋友看见一件新的红色衣服，说：“这件和你的都是红色的。”我说：“我的没有这件大。”

朋友穿了一下，觉得太大了，没有买。他说：“我喜欢红色，我要买可以穿的。漂亮也可以不买。”
questions.label: Take your speaking turn

rubric.text: My suggestion follows from the source situation.
I asked about a real missing detail and allowed a different plan.
